body:
TPG is negotiating to acquire Ark Data Centres from Elliott Investment Management at a valuation of roughly $5 billion, according to people familiar with the matter cited by the Financial Times. The talks are still underway and no agreement has been secured.

Ark, based in Wiltshire, England, runs 27 sites across the UK and Belgium and ranks among Europe's largest independent data center operators. It also holds a joint venture with the UK government's Cabinet Office known as Crown Hosting Data Centres, which gives it access to all UK public sector data center requirements.

Elliott has owned Ark since 2012. Reuters reported last year that the hedge fund was weighing options for the business, including a sale that could have brought in more than $4 billion.

Should the transaction close, it would rank among the largest data center deals struck this year. Neither TPG nor Ark responded to requests for comment made outside business hours, and the report could not be independently verified.

27 facilities in the UK and Belgium

Note: Figures and deal status are as reported by the Financial Times.
